what_it_does: Automated reply sender for the support pipeline — the actual replying half. Volume is replies actually sent in the window.
why_it_matters: Demonstrates the running-but-idle failure mode: the process can stay up and every upstream stage can be busy while zero replies are actually sent in the window. A liveness check alone would call this healthy; only the throughput floor catches it.
